735170101.text: ...So as far as the conclusion is concerned, we've made a convincing case for using the Wenutslayer Cannon to get rid of the Wenut, right?

735170102.text: That's different! Don't give me that "told you so" look!

735170105.text: #Ah, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer! Listen to me! I've found out what the cause is!

735170106.text: The frequent activity of the Wenut underground had caused a disturbance in the Elemental Energy in this region.

735170107.text: This Energy, in turn, affects the behavior of the Wenut, causing them to start running amok on the surface, further exacerbating the environmental imbalance.

735170108.text: The abnormality in the charging device's efficiency was also due to the disturbance of Elemental Energy in the environment.

735170109.text: I knew the machine that I designed would never break down so easily!

735170110.text: If you don't consider the surrounding environment, wouldn't that be a design problem?
